data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model failed to process the PKGBUILD file due to an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in an inconclusive verdict. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) - critical file left unaudited
learnings: When a model fails to process a critical file like PKGBUILD due to API errors, the tool should either retry with the same model or escalate to a different model rather than marking the entire audit as inconclusive
API error handling should distinguish between transient failures (retryable) and permanent failures (escalate to different model)
The audit tool should track which critical files were successfully reviewed vs failed, and only mark as inconclusive when there's genuine analytical disagreement, not tool failures
